title.narrative: Technical assistance to business registration reform in Viet Nam; Phase A Mod II & Phase B

description.narrative: National Business Registration System (NBRS) fully operational in all 63 provinces in Viet Nam, including provision of on-line registration of new enterprises and amendments and on-line information services covering legal enterprise records, annual financial statements of shareholding companies. Enterprises are recognized by a unique ID, Ministry of Planning and Investment and the Ministry of Finance (General Department of Tax) are linked on-line and share real time information on enterprises; all Business Registration Offices in every province use an on-line system to register businesses. All information on the NBRS is open to public access.
